description_for_human: Агент поиска работы на hh.ru для Виктора Бузина: анализ вакансий, ATS-адаптация резюме, сопроводительные письма без шаблонов, follow-up и подготовка к интервью.
description_for_model: This plugin helps Viktor Buzin (Head of Software Development, 15+ years, Berlin) with job search on hh.ru. It analyzes vacancies for relevance and ATS keywords, adapts resume blocks to match specific job descriptions, writes concise non-AI-sounding cover letters with real metrics, generates follow-up messages, and prepares interview materials. Always responds in Russian unless the vacancy is in English. Never uses AI clichés or generic phrases in generated texts.
